title: Zephyrine and the Choir
author: A. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Cyrus Vane, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
